title: The most advanced ops brain in the world
author: Marcus Nordstrom
summary: Integrating structured databases, internal logs, and real-time open-web queries into a single autonomous operational layer to coordinate business workflows.

sections.title: Your Startup's Internal Data
sections.body: From tasks to invoices to offer letters — our platform connects to tools like Google Drive, Slack, Quickbooks, Mercury, Ramp, Gusto, Rippling and more. This forms the foundation of the operations brain, pulling raw transactional records and indexing them securely in a semantic vector space.

sections.title: Chore's Database of Best Practices
sections.body: Built from 6+ years and millions of completed tasks across hundreds of startups, we have created the largest knowledge base in startup ops — full of SOPs, hacks, workarounds, and real-world wisdom. When a task is initiated, the ops brain automatically cross-references this repository to choose the most efficient path.

sections.title: The Open Web Integration
sections.body: Our engine supplements its answers with real-time insights from hundreds of trusted web sources — just like ChatGPT or Perplexity. This allows the system to monitor external market changes, compliance updates, and public announcements to adjust operations workflows on the fly.
